payload.decision: git_context 的 identity 去掉分支维度，只保留 {root, git_dir}；context_id 在同一 worktree 内与分支无关。非 Git 的 work 目录保持原 identity（branch=local）不变。SQLite 仍存放在 Git 目录下的 vibe-state/ 或 work 目录的 .project-log/.state/，不进入工作区、不被归档。

payload.rationale: 框架的完成裁决从不依赖 Session Goal：Codex 侧 loopctl goal-sync 只是观察应用层状态，完成出口始终是 vibe goal 的证据门禁。差距不在实现质量而在平台层 vs 插件层——Codex 的续跑是运行时保证，插件续跑依赖 experimental.* hooks，是尽力而为的模拟。把验收写成“等价”会制造无法验证的承诺。
payload.statement: OpenCode 没有平台级原生 Goal。架构上必须区分两层：Project Goal 是业务完成契约，位于 .project-log，由 vibe goal 的证据门禁裁决，与客户端无关，OpenCode 已完整具备；Session Goal 是线程续跑控制器（运行/暂停/恢复/预算/continuation），Codex 由应用层原生 /goal 提供，OpenCode 只能由插件模拟。因此 TASK-072 的验收口径由“与 codex 严格等价”修订为“可观察行为对齐 + 明确降级语义”，并要求 TASK-078 先完成，用真实运行证据决定复用现成插件还是自研。

round 3: a clean filter or EOL conversion could rewrite the ledger on the way into Git
round 4: a bare push obeyed remote.<name>.push / push.default and could publish an unrelated ref
round 5: an unverifiable remote probe was treated as 'the remote does not have the commit'
round 6: git pushurl / self-referential target handling could self-satisfy the verification
round 7: a linked worktree of the knowledge base was not recognised as the same repository
round 8: file:// URLs with a non-canonical authority skipped the self-reference check
round 9: a ~ home-relative target was never expanded, so ~/kb resolved to the knowledge base while the push reported success
